features.description: Auth profile contract, immutable registry, and secret-safe values
acceptance_criteria: AuthProfileRef, SafeProfile, AuthProfilePolicy, ProfileLease, LeaseMode, and AuthProfileBroker exist with the design doc's frozen semantics
All ten browser_auth_* failure categories are defined, unique, and distinct from the existing browser_* set
SensitiveProfileMaterial redacts under String, Error, MarshalJSON, %v, %+v, and %#v; Materialize is the only extraction path
Registry versions are immutable: republish fails, latest resolves to a concrete version, revoked and expired resolve to terminal structured failures
BrowserRunManifest carries alias, profile hash, and resolved version, and never serializes latest, cookies, object references, or provider context IDs
Existing non-authenticated browser tests pass unmodified

features.description: Local encrypted storage-state materialization and destruction
acceptance_criteria: Envelope adapter seals and opens with a per-blob nonce; tampered ciphertext fails closed as browser_auth_materialize_failed
Materialized file is 0600 inside a 0700 session-owned directory, asserted on mode bits
Local provider passes --storage-state alongside --isolated; contents and canonical object reference never enter argv or the MCP config
Destruction is idempotent across success, error, cancellation, and timeout, and a cleanup failure does not mask the primary failure
Two-run isolation test proves run one's mutation is invisible to run two
Startup orphan audit removes stale materializations and records a structured audit event

features.description: Browserbase Context adapter with non-persisting ordinary sessions
acceptance_criteria: Context create, get, and delete go through the injectable bounded HTTP client with no new unbounded path
Ordinary sessions send persist:false and only refresh mode sends persist:true; a read-mode persist request is refused as browser_auth_writeback_denied before any HTTP request
Context IDs are absent from SessionSpec, BrowserRunManifest, JSON, logs, and errors, asserted on containing structs
Stub tests cover auth failure, quota, malformed response, timeout, synchronization delay, expiry, and deletion
The live contract test stays credential-gated and is not a CI dependency

features.description: Lease, account pool, policy preflight, and audit
acceptance_criteria: Lease acquisition is compare-and-set; refresh mode is exclusive, read mode is bounded by MaxConcurrent, and conflict returns browser_auth_lease_conflict deterministically
Account-pool allocation gives distinct profiles per worker and exhaustion is a deterministic structured failure, never silent reuse
Preflight rejects missing, expired, revoked, scope-denied, artifact-denied, and takeover-denied profiles before a browser is provisioned, asserted by a fake provider that fails if called
An authenticated session with no artifact policy or no egress boundary is denied, and the denial names which policy was absent
The lease is released on success, error, cancellation, timeout, and panic, proven by a -race test with parallel workers
Audit events carry alias, profile hash, version, lease safe ID, principal, run/chain/stage, allowed origins, mode, decision, and timestamps, and no secrets

features.description: Bootstrap and refresh CLI, eval wiring, operator guide, and repository gates
acceptance_criteria: bootstrap runs headful with recording disabled and marks the session non-comparable; it is never an eval
A site-adapter interface exists for trusted automated refresh and no generic model-driven password form filler ships, asserted by a test that no path passes a secret into an MCP tool argument
refresh publishes a new immutable version only after post-login verification under an exclusive lease, retires the old version, and records a rollback pointer
--browser-profile alias@version selects a profile in eval-suite and results record the resolved concrete version, never latest
The operator guide covers local keychain/1Password and Cloud Run Secret Manager/KMS, incident response, account pools, and the rotation drill
make test, lint, fmt-check, check-boundaries, and check-file-sizes pass, and the docs site builds
